UxatAw.description: Participant counter shown in the footer bar of the call recording view (the standalone view captured when a call is recorded); {count} is the number of people currently in the call and # renders that number; compact space.

qR+5t1.description: Fragment appended directly after a speaker's display name in the call widget and recording-view footer (e.g. 'Alice is talking…'); concatenated with the name, so it must work as a sentence continuation; keep the trailing ellipsis.
